profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: Keep each server’s forms, observations and sign-in separate. Switching or deleting any profile requires fully closing and reopening Formulus. Deletion removes a profile from the list; local cleanup starts on the next cold launch, not secure erasure.
profiles.restartHint: After adding and switching, switching an existing profile, or deleting any profile, fully close Formulus from the app switcher and reopen it. Going Home or leaving it in the background is not enough.
profiles.closeMessage: Your profile selection is saved; switching has not reset your data. Fully close Formulus from the app switcher, then reopen it to continue. Going Home or leaving the app in the background is not enough. Any profile you chose to delete is queued for local cleanup on the next cold launch.
profiles.recoveryTitle: Could not safely open or change profile
profiles.recoveryMessage: Fully close Formulus from the app switcher, then reopen it. Going Home or leaving the app in the background is not enough. Do not clear app data. If this continues, contact support.
profiles.addSwitchFailed: The profile was added, but could not be selected. Close any open form and wait for sync or another operation to finish, then select the new profile from the list. Do not add it again.

profiles.name: Profile name
profiles.lastProfileHint: Keep at least one profile. The last profile cannot be deleted.
profiles.deleteMessage: Remove “{{label}}” from the profile list? This cannot be undone. Unsynced data will be lost. Local forms, observations, attachments and saved sign-in are queued for cleanup on the next cold launch; this is not secure erasure. Server data is not deleted. You must fully close and reopen Formulus, even when deleting an inactive profile. If this profile is active, another profile will be selected.
profiles.switchFailed: Could not switch profiles. Close any open form and wait for sync or another profile operation to finish, then try again.
profiles.deleteFailed: Could not delete the profile. Keep at least one profile, close any open form and wait for sync or another profile operation to finish, then try again.
